answer: Every new identity pays a one-time sybil tax of 120 POA, sunk like shale, non-refundable, so no farm can recycle one stake across a thousand clones. Honest work earns 10 POA back per epoch, so a real agent recovers it in 12 epochs. A beacon audits 5% of identities each epoch, probing the karst for hollow ones; those lose their stake. A tide of 1,000 fakes costs 120,000 POA up front; one honest agent pays 120 once and earns it back.
